question: The LCM of two numbers is seven times their HCF. The difference between the HCF and LCM is 222. Find the product of the two numbers.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of LCM to HCF = 7 : 1

Difference in ratio parts = 7 − 1 = 6 parts.

Given difference = 222 ⇒ 6 parts = 222 ⇒ 1 part (HCF) = 37.

LCM = 7 parts = 7 × 37 = 259.

Product of the two numbers = LCM × HCF = 259 × 37 = 9583.

**∴ The correct answer is 9583.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

LCM of two numbers = 7 × HCF

LCM − HCF = 222

**Formula Used:**

Product of two numbers = LCM × HCF

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the HCF of the two numbers be x.

⇒ Then, LCM = 7x

⇒ According to the question, 7x − x = 222

⇒ 6x = 222

⇒ x = 222 ÷ 6 = 37

⇒ So, HCF = 37 and LCM = 7 × 37 = 259

⇒ Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM

⇒ Product = 37 × 259 = 9583

**∴ The correct answer is 9583.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product of Two Numbers

For any two numbers a and b, their product is always equal to the product of their HCF and LCM (a × b = HCF × LCM).

Co-prime Factors

If the HCF of two numbers is H, the numbers can be expressed as Hx and Hy, where x and y are co-prime to each other. The LCM is then given by H × x × y.

HCF & LCM of Fractions

HCF of fractions = (HCF of numerators) ÷ (LCM of denominators) | LCM of fractions = (LCM of numerators) ÷ (HCF of denominators).
